estonia.description: Endless entertainment leads to an ever more simplified culture, and an ever more simplified culture eventually collapses into primitiveness, incompetence and infantilism — inevitably producing a society that can no longer cope with itself, writes Maarja Vaino.

estonia.title: Delfi poll: Nearly a third back Ülle Madise as next president
estonia.description: Chancellor of Justice Ülle Madise was the people's pick for president by nearly a third of respondents to a survey, Delfi reported.

estonia.title: Estonian traders not daunted by ban on destroying unsold clothing
estonia.description: A ban on selling unsold clothing and footwear will have little impact on Estonian retailers and manufacturers, as discounts generally help them sell nearly all their products.

estonia.title: Tune in: ERR picks on Estonia's Restoration of Independence Day
estonia.description: August 20 marks 35 years since Estonia regained independence. Join the celebrations with ERR's live coverage, specials, films and music on TV, online and on the airwaves.

estonia.title: Mari‑Liis Sööt: When changing penal policy, we must keep a cool head
estonia.description: A punishment for a crime does not need to be light or harsh — it needs to be effective. Estonia's past success does not mean we can continue with an unchanged penal policy, writes Mari‑Liis Sööt.

estonia.title: Estonian farmers to rally in Tallinn against major subsidy cuts
estonia.description: The Estonian Chamber of Agriculture and Commerce (EPKK) will organize a protest lasting up to two days in Tallinn next week to oppose the government's plan to cut nearly half of the European Commission's proposed funding for Estonian agriculture and the food industry.

estonia.title: Scientists recommend not swimming in bog pools to help retain biodiversity
estonia.description: Bog pools are sensitive to large numbers of visitors and frequent swimming alters their ecosystems. To preserve biodiversity, scientists recommend swimming in other bodies of water.

estonia.title: Animation festival in Japan to spotlight Estonia's Priit and Olga Pärn
estonia.description: Japan's Hiroshima Animation Season is putting Estonia's Priit and Olga Pärn in the spotlight this year with two retrospective programs celebrating their distinctive worlds.

estonia.title: Tallinn public transport, traffic disruptions confirmed over Ironman weekend
estonia.description: Significant traffic changes are to affect Tallinn public transport, drivers and pedestrians this coming weekend as the city hosts the annual Ironman triathlon event.

estonia.title: Wildlife expert: No large wild animal in Estonia seeks to attack humans
estonia.description: Peep Männil, a wildlife expert at the Environmental Agency, says that estimating the numbers of large carnivores involves drones, trail cameras, tracking signs, observations and bioacoustics. No large wild animal in Estonia seeks out humans, he adds.

estonia.title: TUHANDETE UNISTUSE TÄITUMINE ⟩ Duo Ruut avaldas Spotify's tantsupeoliste kaua igatsetud pala
estonia.description: Pärimusmuusikaansambel Duo Ruut avaldas kolmapäeval voogedastusplatvormil Spotify mulluse üldtantsupeo jaoks kirjutatud pala «See on väljade laul». Sellega tuli ansambel vastu tuhandetele tantsijatele, kes pärast tantsupidu neilt selle laulu kättesaadavaks tegemist on palunud.

estonia.title: Anthony Fauci endine abiline tunnistas end süüdi pandeemia-aegses vandenõus
estonia.description: End teisipäeval kirjavahetuse varjamises süüdi tunnistanud USA tervishoiuametnik David Morens oli salaja lubanud taastada toetused Hiina Wuhani laboratooriumi töö jaoks ja kummutas samal ajal väiteid, et Covid-19 viirus pärines laborist, kirjutab The Telegraph.

estonia.title: Venelasel Aleksandr Bolšunovil sai mõõt täis: kaua peame veel ootama?
estonia.description: Venemaa murdmaasuusatamise täht Aleksandr Bolšunov ei jaksa enam oodata, millal tema ja teised sõda toetavad venelased lastakse tagasi rahvusvahelistele võistlustele.

estonia.title: Võta vaba päev pere jaoks: mida ühine aeg meie suhetega tegelikult teeb
estonia.description: Me ei pea alati midagi suurt korraldama, et ühel koos veedetud hetkel oleks tähendus. Mõnikord piisab ühest lauast, tuttavast toidust või kokkuleppest, et sel päeval ollakse koos. Just korduvad ühised hetked võivad anda inimesele olulise tunde, et ta kuulub kuhugi.

estonia.title: Miks diagnoositakse autismi üha rohkem? Teadlase seisukoht põhjustab vaidlusi
estonia.description: Viimastel aastatel on teadlikkus autismist hüppeliselt kasvanud kõikjal maailmas, sealhulgas ka Eestis, tuues kaasa diagnooside arvu kiire suurenemise. Üks maailma juhtivaid autismiteadlasi hoiatab aga, et diagnoosimise piirid on hägustunud ning autismispekter on muutunud niivõrd laiaks, et diagnoosi võib saada sisuliselt igaüks, sõltumata vanusest või intellektist.

estonia.title: KARUMS ON NÜÜD MEIE ⟩ Eesti ettevõte ostab Läti suurima piimatööstuse, kus tehakse ka kuulsaid kohukesi
estonia.description: Eesti suurima põllumajanduskontserni ja regiooni suurima sõltumatu toorpiimatootja Agrone emaettevõte Falber Investments OÜ sõlmis kokkuleppe Läti suurima piimatöötlemisettevõtte, AS-i Rīgas piena kombināts kontserni omandamiseks.

estonia.description: Siseminister Igor Taro tegi PPA peadirektorile ettepaneku, et PPA sisekontrollibüroo uuriks politsei reageerimist Viimsi peksujuhtumile.

latvia.description: Ha nem lett volna politikai indíttatású a településeket az „önazonossági rendelet” megalkotására felhatalmazó törvény, talán néhány problémát is megoldott volna. A nemkívánatos betelepülőket helyi jogszabállyal korlátozó képviselő-testületek „futnak a pénzük után”.

latvia.description: A miniszter szerint az elmúlt másfél évtizedben olyan rendszer épült ki Magyarországon, amely meg akarta mondani, ki a jó magyar és ki nem.

latvia.description: A 36 milliárdos uniós tendert a NER-ben is jól fekvő osztrák Swietelsky nyerte.

latvia.title: Lángokba borult a hadiipari vállalat a NATO országában: orosz szabotázsakciót sejtenek
latvia.description: Észtország lehetséges orosz érintettséget vizsgál egy védelmiipari vállalat, a Milrem Robotics tallinni épülete ellen elkövetett feltételezett gyújtogatás ügyében - írta a Kyiv Post .

latvia.title: Ukrajna brutális tűz alá vette Moszkvát, titkos orosz drónbázisokról rántották le a leplet – Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról kedden
latvia.description: Két év óta a legnagyobb ukrán dróntámadás érte Moszkvát az éjszaka Szergej Szobjanyin moszkvai polgármester által közzétett adatok szerint. Az ukránok 620 drónt indítottak Moszkva felé, melyek közül 180-at megsemmisített az orosz légvédelem. Legalább tíz új orosz dróntámaszpontot azonosított Oroszország Belarusszal és Ukrajnával határos területe mentén a Telegraph. A bázisokról Moszkva akár a NATO területe felé is indíthatna nagy hatótávolságú támadódrónokat, amelyek elérhetik akár Varsót is - írja a brit lap . Az orosz legfelsőbb bíróság hétfőn helybenhagyta korábbi ítéletét, egyúttal elutasította a Jabloko liberális ellenzéki párt fellebbezését, amelynek ezáltal jogerősen törlik a szeptemberi alsóházi választásra állított országos listáját. Az ellehetetlenített Jabloko az indulók közül egyedüliként ellenezte volna az ukrajnai háborút. Az ellenzéki tömörülés alelnökét, Lev Sloszberget tegnap 11 év és egy hónap börtönbüntetésre ítélte egy városi bíróság , amiért a vád szerint rágalmazta az orosz hadsereget. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legutóbbi fejleményeivel.

latvia.title: Tarr Zoltán bocsánatot kért a kormány nevében – évtizedes helyzetet változtatna meg
latvia.description: A határon túli magyar közösségekkel való egyenrangú partnerség kiépítését, valamint a nemzetpolitika pártpolitikai érdekektől való megtisztítását ígéri Tarr Zoltán. A Kolozsvári Magyar Napok alkalmából küldött köszöntőjében bocsánatot kért a határon túli magyaroktól az elmúlt másfél évtized megosztó politikájáért, és hangsúlyozta, hogy a támogatásokat a jövőben nem kötik majd párthűséghez – fejtette ki gondolatait a társadalmi kapcsolatokért és kultúráért felelős miniszter egy Facebook-bejegyzésben .

latvia.title: Kolaps NATO a rozklad EÚ zvnútra. Putin sa po Ukrajine zameral na strategickú prioritu číslo dva
latvia.description: Moldavsko má pre Kremeľ mimoriadny význam.

latvia.title: NATO kreslí plán vojny s Ruskom. Aliancia opisuje, kam by smeroval prvý úder
latvia.description: NATO vypracovalo koncept vedenia pozemných bojových operácií pre prípad ruskej agresie proti členským štátom aliancie. Dokument počíta s postupnou reakciou na raketové a dronové útoky aj na následnú ofenzívu ruských pozemných síl. Informoval o tom denník Bild, ktorý cituje dokument NATO Land Warfighting Concept.

latvia.title: Francouzské stíhačky překvapily nad Baltem letoun šéfů ruské tajné služby FSB
latvia.description: Francouzské letectvo zveřejnilo v rámci své zprávy o účasti v misi NATO nad Pobaltím snímky, na nichž stíhačka Rafale monitoruje ruský Tupolev Tu-214. Jde o letoun vybavený laserovým systémem sebeobrany LSZ-100, jímž létá vedení ruské tajné služby FSB. Systém LSZ-100 pak mají také stroje, které „vozí“ ruského prezidenta Vladimira Putina.

latvia.title: O Oscara pro Česko bude usilovat osobní dokument o závislosti
latvia.description: Do klání o mezinárodního Oscara vyslala Česká filmová a televizní akademie (ČFTA) celovečerní dokument režisérky Pepy Lubojacki Kdyby se holubi proměnili ve zlato. Snímek natočený v koprodukci České televize měl premiéru na festivalu Berlinale, kde získal cenu za nejlepší dokumentární film a také vedlejší nezávislé ocenění Caligari. Do české kinodistribuce oficiálně vstoupí na konci září.

latvia.title: Noile reguli pentru admiterea la liceu, criticate de părinți: „Copiii se vor lupta cu arme inegale”
latvia.description: Părinții se tem că noile reguli pentru admiterea la liceu, care ar permite colegiilor să organizeze examene proprii pentru o parte dintre locuri, vor aduce un stres suplimentar pentru elevi și vor favoriza familiile care își permit meditații. Unii părinți vorbesc chiar despre riscul ca examenele să devină o „formalitate” și să apară „pile” la liceele dorite. Roxana Paraschiv, coordonator de program la Salvați Copiii, avertizează că introducerea unor probe suplimentare ar adânci diferențele dintre elevi și ar putea afecta sănătatea mintală a copiilor.

latvia.title: NATO dă asigurări că poate aborda „oricare amenințare”. Reacția vizează în special Teheranul
latvia.description: Alianţa Nord-Atlantică este pregătită să abordeze orice ameninţare şi va face întotdeauna tot ce este necesar pentru a-şi apăra aliaţii, a declarat miercuri un oficial al NATO, relatează Reuters. Afirmaţia a venit ca răspuns la întrebări despre un articol din Financial Times conform căruia Iranul ar lua în considerare atacarea de ţinte militare americane din Europa, în cazul în care preşedintele SUA, Donald Trump, ar escalada războiul.

latvia.title: Elveția își cheamă cetățenii la urne pentru a lua o decizie istorică privind neutralitatea
latvia.description: Se pare că alegătorii elvețieni vor respinge luna viitoare propunerile privind o definiție mai strictă a neutralității, care ar împiedica țara să impună sancțiuni economice sau să coopereze cu NATO, potrivit unui sondaj publicat miercuri, transmite reuters.

latvia.title: Melania „nu agreează” speculațiile privind relația lui Trump cu una dintre colaboratoarele sale. Cine este Nathalie Harp
latvia.description: Speculațiile privind relația lui Donald Trump cu una dintre cele mai apropiate colaboratoare ale sale o deranjează pe soția sa, Melania, potrivit unor rapoarte. Administrația Trump a ripostat după ce senatorul Jon Ossoff a glumit luni că președintele SUA ar fi distras de o aventură extraconjugală cu Natalie Harp, asistenta executivă a președintelui american în vârstă de 80 de ani.

latvia.title: Rușii donează miliarde pentru războiul lui Putin din Ucraina. Suma impresionantă strânsă în vistieria statului
latvia.description: Donatorii ruși au vărsat peste 383 de miliarde de ruble (4,5 miliarde de dolari) în vistieria statului în urma unui apel pentru contribuții voluntare, pe măsură ce costul războiului Moscovei împotriva Ucrainei continuă să crească, informează cotidianul de afaceri Vedomosti, citat de agenția DPA.

latvia.title: Cazul avionului chinez interceptat de avioane maghiare de luptă la granița cu România. Ancheta a dezvăluit cauza incidentului
latvia.description: Un avion al companiei Cathay Pacific, cu sediul în Hong Kong, a fost interceptat de două avioane de vânătoare maghiare ale NATO deasupra spațiului aerian românesc. Incidentul a avut loc pe 4 iulie. Acum, ancheta în acest caz arată că pilotul a selectat o frecvență radio greșită după ce a răspuns din greșeală la instrucțiunile controlului de trafic aerian destinate unei alte aeronave.

latvia.title: Strategia detaliată a NATO pentru un război terestru cu Rusia: drone, zone autonome și ținte surpriză în Kaliningrad
latvia.description: Alianța Nord-Atlantică a elaborat un plan detaliat de acțiune în cazul unui conflict armat cu Rusia. Acesta a fost denumit „NATO Land Warfighting Concept” — „Concepția NATO privind operațiunile terestre”, relatează ziarul Bild, citând surse. Elaborarea concepției a fost coordonată de maiorul american Andrew Pingray.

latvia.title: Trump, acuzat că slăbește alianțele SUA, după anunțul privind reducerea exercițiilor alături de Coreea de Sud: „China și Rusia observă”
latvia.description: Decizia preşedintelui american Donald Trump de a reduce amploarea exerciţiilor militare comune între SUA şi Coreea de Sud este „stupidă şi incoerentă”, a denunţat, luni, senatorul american Jack Reed, principalul reprezentant democrat în Comisia pentru forţele armate, relatează France Presse.

latvia.title: KARUMS ON NÜÜD MEIE ⟩ Eesti ettevõte ostab Läti suurima piimatööstuse, kus tehakse ka kuulsaid kohukesi
latvia.description: Eesti suurima põllumajanduskontserni ja regiooni suurima sõltumatu toorpiimatootja Agrone emaettevõte Falber Investments OÜ sõlmis kokkuleppe Läti suurima piimatöötlemisettevõtte, AS-i Rīgas piena kombināts kontserni omandamiseks.

latvia.title: KUKU ⟩ Õhuhäired lükkasid Zelenskõi ja Eesti suursaadiku volikirjatseremoonia tundide võrra edasi
latvia.description: Eesti suursaadik Ukrainas Tiina Intelmann andis teisipäeval üle oma volikirja Ukraina presidendile Volodõmõr Zelenskõile. Kiievi Püha Sofia katedraali territooriumil toimunud tseremooniat mõjutas sõjategevus ja kavandatust jäi see mitu tundi hilisemaks, rääkis Intelmann Kuku raadio saates «Sihik».

latvia.title: Canadian military band starts tour of Latvia
latvia.description: The Central Band of the Canadian Armed Forces is visiting Latvia from August 19th to September 3rd, participating in events dedicated to the 35th anniversary of the National Guard and giving a series of concerts.

latvia.title: Popular advocate of Livonian culture takes leading role
latvia.description: On August 19th, a meeting of the National Cultural Council was held at the Ministry of Culture (KM), where one of the issues was the election of the chairperson and deputy chairperson of the council itself.

latvia.title: Slight increase in hotel stays in second quarter of 2026 in Latvia
latvia.description: According to the Central Statistical Bureau data published on August 19, in Q2 2026 the number of non-resident and resident arrivals at Latvian tourist accommodation establishments comprised 750.0 thousand, which is an increase of 1.2 % compared with Q2 2025.

latvia.title: Affordable rental flats to be built in Rīga
latvia.description: By 2030, it is planned to build 732 affordable rental homes in Rīga – in the Pļavnieki, Ziepniekkalns, and Bolderāja disctricts, according to the agency State Real Estate (Valsts nekustamie īpašumi, VNĪ).

latvia.title: Latvian police say they have thwarted prison conspiracy
latvia.description: The State Police claimed on August 19 that they have foiled a plan organised from within prison to rob and severely beat a man, the police have reported.

latvia.title: 'Operation Werewolf' sniffs out more illegal border crossers
latvia.description: On Tuesday, August 18th, in Krāslava district, soldiers of the National Armed Forces detained someone who was transporting persons who had illegally crossed the state border, according to releases from the State Border Guard and the government.

latvia.title: New tree park to be planted in Latvia as part of World Cleanup Day
latvia.description: In one month's time a 10th Happiness Tree Park will be opened as part of the World Cleanup Day, which will take place in approximately 200 countries on September 20th, including Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian CSDD bosses step down
latvia.description: All board members of the Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD) have submitted a letter to the Minister for Transport, Rihards Kozlovskis (New Unity), Kozlovskis said on Wednesday, August 19.

latvia.title: Latvian and Lithuanian national militias stand shoulder to shoulder
latvia.description: Celebrating the 35th anniversary of the National Guard (Zemessardze), the National Guard has signed a memorandum of cooperation with the Lithuanian Riflemen's Union (Lietuvos šaulių sąjunga) to strengthen cooperation and exchange of experience between the two organizations.

latvia.title: Latvian citizen to be prosecuted for war glorification
latvia.description: On 14 August this year, the State Security Service (VDD) urged the Public Prosecutor’s Office to initiate criminal proceedings against a Latvian citizen for the prolonged and systematic glorification and justification of the war waged by Russia in Ukraine, inciting hatred against Ukrainians, as well as the unauthorised possession of a high-powered air gun and explosives.

latvia.title: New rules will let Latvian army requisition private land in an emergency
latvia.description: On Tuesday, August 18th, the Cabinet of Ministers supported amendments to the National Security Law proposed by the Ministry of Defence, which provide for granting the National Armed Forces the temporary right to use land owned by private individuals, if it is deemed necessary for national defence.

latvia.title: CSDD boss ready to quit over massive database leak
latvia.description: The head of the Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD), Aivars Aksenoks, is preparing to resign from his position after the investigation into the cyberattack that the CSDD experienced in early August is completed, Aksenoks announced in an interview with Latvian Television's "Morning Panorama" on August 19th.

latvia.title: 'Psychics' scam two women for over 150 thousand euros in Latvia
latvia.description: Two women, having fallen for advertisements posted on the social networking site ‘Facebook’ which purported to offer the services of psychics, transferred a total of more than 150,000 euros to the fraudsters, the State Police reported on August 18.

latvia.title: Some rain across most of Latvia Wednesday
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that brief showers are expected in many parts of Latvia on Wednesday.

latvia.title: Ban on credit advertising lifted in Latvia
latvia.description: From Wednesday, 18 August, the ban on consumer credit advertising has been lifted, whilst strict requirements have been imposed on the content of such adverts, Latvian Radio reported on August 19.

latvia.title: Latvian government weakens protection for larger trees
latvia.description: The Latvian government decided on Tuesday, August 18, that larger trees will be allowed to be cut down outside forests than were previously allowed to be felled.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 18th August, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Ukrainians plan to sing Latvian national anthem in Rīga
latvia.description: At midday on August 22nd, at at the Freedom Monument in Rīga, the Latvian anthem will ring out, but this time it will not be sung by Latvians.

latvia.title: Data of 1.2 million people breached in recent CSDD cyberattack
latvia.description: The Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD) reported on August 18 that personal data relating to 1.2 million people was obtained in a cyberattack. Latvia's total population is a little over 1.8 million, so as a proportion of the population, the breach is enormous.

latvia.title: Latvian State Police wants to put lawyer in the dock
latvia.description: The Latvian State Police has completed an investigation into the actions of sworn attorney Inese Šulte and another private individual, requesting that both be charged with attemtping to influence a suspect, the LETA newswire reports.

latvia.title: Special Saeima sitting will mark 35th restoration of 'de facto' independence
latvia.description: On August 21st – the day when Latvia's independence was de facto restored 35 years ago – the Saeima will gather for a special ceremonial sitting at 12:00.

latvia.title: Only in Latvia: new train named after particularly popular mushroom
latvia.description: The Latvian mania for funghi is well documented, and on August 18th gets another entry with news that a shiny new passenger train will be honoured with the name of a particularly popular species of edible mushroom.

latvia.title: Latvia spends less than EU average on education
latvia.description: New data published by Eurostat shows levels of public spending on education across the European Union – and reveals that Latvia spends less than the majority of its EU peers on this crucial investment in the future.

latvia.title: Latvia's Oscar nominee is 'Ulya'
latvia.description: Viesturs Kairišs' feature film Uļa (Ulya) has been named Latvia's candidate for the Academy Awards this year, according to representatives of the National Film Centre (NKC).

latvia.title: More sauce? Spilva expands its Babīte factory
latvia.description: Food manufacturer “Orkla Latvija” plans to invest 5.4 million euros in the modernisation of the “Spilva” sauce and ready-meal production facility in Babīte, the company said on August 18.

latvia.title: Four migrants caught in Ķekava municipality, Latvia
latvia.description: On Tuesday morning, August 18, the Ķekava Municipal Police detained four migrants on the Rīga bypass between the Daugmale roundabout and the Riga Hydroelectric Power Station and handed them over to the State Border Guard, the municipal police said.

latvia.title: Public invited to choose their Latvian building of the year
latvia.description: The organizers of the Best Building of the Year in Latvia 2025 competition – the Latvian Builders' Association and the Latvian Union of Civil Engineers – are inviting the public to vote for the buildings submitted for the competition and put into operation in 2025, which are of the most benefit to society.

latvia.title: Call to halt law on mandatory dubbing of films in Latvian
latvia.description: The Latvian Association of Broadcasters, Latvian Public Media (LSM) and the Latvian Film Producers’ Association call on the Saeima not to support the amendments to the Electronic Mass Media Law, which would require television content in languages other than the official languages of the European Union (EU) Member States to be dubbed in Latvian.

latvia.title: Vidzeme farmers happy with this year's grain harvest
latvia.description: Combine harvesters are active in the grain fields of Vidzeme right now as they seek to get their grain into storage during dry conditions. Farmers assess this year as successful in terms of harvest, despite increases in the price of mineral fertilizers and fuel, and some rains early in the season.

latvia.title: 'Buckle up' signal to sound throughout Latvia on Tuesday
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 18 August, at 11:00, a signal warning of a seatbelt not being fastened will be broadcast on radio stations and at petrol stations. This will mark the start of the Road Traffic Safety Directorate’s (CSDD) new campaign: “The last dance begins without a seatbelt. Don’t take chances – buckle up!”, CSDD said in a release.

latvia.title: Rinkēvičs: Latvia lacks border guards
latvia.description: Significant progress has been made in the construction of infrastructure along the Latvian–Belarusian border, but there are serious problems with human resources – this was the conclusion reached by President Edgars Rinkēvičs during a visit to Piedruja, a village on the border with Belarus, on August 18.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 17th August, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: airBaltic bondholders agree to capitalise interest payments
latvia.description: Bondholders of the national airline ‘airBaltic’ voted in favour of capitalising interest payments on the bonds at a meeting on Monday, 17 August, the airline announced.

latvia.title: State Security Service demands prosecution of Daugavpils separatist
latvia.description: On August 17th, the Latvian State Security Service (VDD) said that a week earlier it had asked the Prosecution Office to initiate criminal prosecution against a Latvian 'non-citizen' for expressing support towards ideas directed against the territorial integrity of Latvia.

latvia.title: President Rinkēvičs returns to Latvia's eastern border
latvia.description: On August 17th Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs made another one of his regular visits to the country's eastern border.

latvia.title: Diver lost in Baltic sea in July found
latvia.description: The body of a diver who went missing in mid-July has been found in the sea off Roja, the State Police (VP) reported on Monday, 17 August.

latvia.title: Latvian central bank's 'Financial Stability Report' available in English
latvia.description: The Latvian central bank, Latvijas Banka (LB) has published its annual Financial Stability Report in English. A report has been published every year since 2003 "to raise public awareness regarding the development of the Latvian financial system and to draw attention to systemic risks."

latvia.title: Finance Minister, central bank governor talk future EU funds
latvia.description: At the end of last week, Finance Minister Māris Kučinskis (United List) met with Bank of Latvia (LB) Governor Mārtiņš Kazāks to discuss possible cooperation between the Ministry of Finance (FM) and the LB in preparation for the next European Union (EU) funds planning period 2028-2034.

latvia.title: Company registration numbers down in Latvia, but so are bankruptcies
latvia.description: In the second quarter of 2026, registrations of businesses in the EU decreased by 0.5% compared with the first quarter of 2026, while bankruptcies increased by 5.7% according to data on business registrations and bankruptcies published by Eurostat today.

latvia.title: Latvians spent EUR 619 monthly on household needs last year
latvia.description: In 2025, mean monthly household consumption expenditure per household member amounted to 619 euros, according to Central Statistical Bureau data published on August 17.

latvia.title: Scammer e-mails 'from Swedbank' active again in Latvia
latvia.description: On Monday, August 17, Swedbank customers have again received targeted emails from scammers, Swedbank said in a statement.

latvia.title: Drone that was shot down in Latvia entered from Belarus
latvia.description: The drone shot down in the Balvi region on Friday flew into Latvian airspace from Belarus, Defence Minister Raivis Melnis said in an interview on Latvian Television on Monday morning.

latvia.title: 'Last chance' to save airBaltic, says Latvian Prime Minister
latvia.description: Latvian Television's 'De Facto' investigative show reported on August 16th on the current situation at Latvia's cash-strapped national airline, airBaltic.

latvia.title: All fairly quiet in Latvian border area since 'Operation Werewolf'
latvia.description: Since the start of Operation ‘Vilkatis’ (Werewolf), which aims to increase monitoring of the movement of illegal migrants and their smugglers along the country’s border, no one has been detained, Defence Minister Raivis Melnis said in an interview with Latvian Radio and Latvian Television on Monday morning.

latvia.title: Weather will improve later in the week in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that rain is expected more frequently in Latvia during the first half of the week.

latvia.title: Political poster exhibition opens at Latvian National Library
latvia.description: With the Saeima elections fast approaching in October, an exhibition of political posters entitled “The Language of Power – Agitation, Propaganda, Art” opens on Monday, August 17, at the National Library of Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian State Forests blames miscommunication for recent cyber attack
latvia.description: Earlier this summer, the Latvian State Forests (LVM) IT systems suffered a cyber attack. It happened through a vulnerability that hadn't been updated in two years, although LVM had been notified of it, Latvian Television's De Facto reports on August 16.

latvia.title: LSM launches charity drive for Ukrainian soldiers' rehabilitation
latvia.description: To mark Ukraine’s Independence Day on 24 August, Latvian Public Media (LSM), in collaboration with “Ziedot.lv”, is organising a fundraising campaign from Monday, 17 August, until 13 September, to provide Ukrainian soldiers with comprehensive rehabilitation.

latvia.title: Rain and thunder in Latvia on Monday
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that brief showers are expected in many parts of Latvia on Monday, with thunderstorms in some areas.

latvia.description: Personas datiem nav viena universāla glabāšanas termiņa un tas ir atkarīgs no datu apstrādes nolūka, tiesiskā pamata un citām prasībām, aģentūrai LETA sacīja Datu valsts inspekcijas (VDI) sabiedrisko attiecību speciāliste Ginta Gailuma, komentējot Ceļu satiksmes drošības direkcijas (CSDD) kiberincidentu, kurā iegūti personu dati kopš 2008. gada. Viņa uzsver, ka to, kādēļ konkrētie dati tika glabāti […]

Tarr Zoltán bocsánatot kért az előző kormányok „háborús pszichózisa” és gyűlölködése miatt
lithuania.description: Rendszerváltást ígért a határon túli politikában is a társadalmi kapcsolatokért és kultúráért felelős miniszter.

lithuania.title: „Ne legyen igazam: ezt az egész törvényt ki fogják herélni” – nagy kapufa lett Orbánék faluvédő koncepciója
lithuania.description: Ha nem lett volna politikai indíttatású a településeket az „önazonossági rendelet” megalkotására felhatalmazó törvény, talán néhány problémát is megoldott volna. A nemkívánatos betelepülőket helyi jogszabállyal korlátozó képviselő-testületek „futnak a pénzük után”.

lithuania.title: Tarr Zoltán bocsánatot kér a határon túli magyaroktól, amiért az előző kormány politikai eszközként használta őket
lithuania.description: A miniszter szerint az elmúlt másfél évtizedben olyan rendszer épült ki Magyarországon, amely meg akarta mondani, ki a jó magyar és ki nem.

lithuania.title: Négy év múlva már 160-nal roboghatnak a vonatok a komáromi vonalon Vitézy szerint
lithuania.description: A 36 milliárdos uniós tendert a NER-ben is jól fekvő osztrák Swietelsky nyerte.

lithuania.title: Lángokba borult a hadiipari vállalat a NATO országában: orosz szabotázsakciót sejtenek
lithuania.description: Észtország lehetséges orosz érintettséget vizsgál egy védelmiipari vállalat, a Milrem Robotics tallinni épülete ellen elkövetett feltételezett gyújtogatás ügyében - írta a Kyiv Post .

lithuania.title: Ukrajna brutális tűz alá vette Moszkvát, titkos orosz drónbázisokról rántották le a leplet – Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról kedden
lithuania.description: Két év óta a legnagyobb ukrán dróntámadás érte Moszkvát az éjszaka Szergej Szobjanyin moszkvai polgármester által közzétett adatok szerint. Az ukránok 620 drónt indítottak Moszkva felé, melyek közül 180-at megsemmisített az orosz légvédelem. Legalább tíz új orosz dróntámaszpontot azonosított Oroszország Belarusszal és Ukrajnával határos területe mentén a Telegraph. A bázisokról Moszkva akár a NATO területe felé is indíthatna nagy hatótávolságú támadódrónokat, amelyek elérhetik akár Varsót is - írja a brit lap . Az orosz legfelsőbb bíróság hétfőn helybenhagyta korábbi ítéletét, egyúttal elutasította a Jabloko liberális ellenzéki párt fellebbezését, amelynek ezáltal jogerősen törlik a szeptemberi alsóházi választásra állított országos listáját. Az ellehetetlenített Jabloko az indulók közül egyedüliként ellenezte volna az ukrajnai háborút. Az ellenzéki tömörülés alelnökét, Lev Sloszberget tegnap 11 év és egy hónap börtönbüntetésre ítélte egy városi bíróság , amiért a vád szerint rágalmazta az orosz hadsereget. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legutóbbi fejleményeivel.

lithuania.title: Tarr Zoltán bocsánatot kért a kormány nevében – évtizedes helyzetet változtatna meg
lithuania.description: A határon túli magyar közösségekkel való egyenrangú partnerség kiépítését, valamint a nemzetpolitika pártpolitikai érdekektől való megtisztítását ígéri Tarr Zoltán. A Kolozsvári Magyar Napok alkalmából küldött köszöntőjében bocsánatot kért a határon túli magyaroktól az elmúlt másfél évtized megosztó politikájáért, és hangsúlyozta, hogy a támogatásokat a jövőben nem kötik majd párthűséghez – fejtette ki gondolatait a társadalmi kapcsolatokért és kultúráért felelős miniszter egy Facebook-bejegyzésben .

lithuania.title: Kolaps NATO a rozklad EÚ zvnútra. Putin sa po Ukrajine zameral na strategickú prioritu číslo dva
lithuania.description: Moldavsko má pre Kremeľ mimoriadny význam.

lithuania.title: NATO kreslí plán vojny s Ruskom. Aliancia opisuje, kam by smeroval prvý úder
lithuania.description: NATO vypracovalo koncept vedenia pozemných bojových operácií pre prípad ruskej agresie proti členským štátom aliancie. Dokument počíta s postupnou reakciou na raketové a dronové útoky aj na následnú ofenzívu ruských pozemných síl. Informoval o tom denník Bild, ktorý cituje dokument NATO Land Warfighting Concept.

lithuania.title: Francouzské stíhačky překvapily nad Baltem letoun šéfů ruské tajné služby FSB
lithuania.description: Francouzské letectvo zveřejnilo v rámci své zprávy o účasti v misi NATO nad Pobaltím snímky, na nichž stíhačka Rafale monitoruje ruský Tupolev Tu-214. Jde o letoun vybavený laserovým systémem sebeobrany LSZ-100, jímž létá vedení ruské tajné služby FSB. Systém LSZ-100 pak mají také stroje, které „vozí“ ruského prezidenta Vladimira Putina.

lithuania.title: O Oscara pro Česko bude usilovat osobní dokument o závislosti
lithuania.description: Do klání o mezinárodního Oscara vyslala Česká filmová a televizní akademie (ČFTA) celovečerní dokument režisérky Pepy Lubojacki Kdyby se holubi proměnili ve zlato. Snímek natočený v koprodukci České televize měl premiéru na festivalu Berlinale, kde získal cenu za nejlepší dokumentární film a také vedlejší nezávislé ocenění Caligari. Do české kinodistribuce oficiálně vstoupí na konci září.

lithuania.title: Noile reguli pentru admiterea la liceu, criticate de părinți: „Copiii se vor lupta cu arme inegale”
lithuania.description: Părinții se tem că noile reguli pentru admiterea la liceu, care ar permite colegiilor să organizeze examene proprii pentru o parte dintre locuri, vor aduce un stres suplimentar pentru elevi și vor favoriza familiile care își permit meditații. Unii părinți vorbesc chiar despre riscul ca examenele să devină o „formalitate” și să apară „pile” la liceele dorite. Roxana Paraschiv, coordonator de program la Salvați Copiii, avertizează că introducerea unor probe suplimentare ar adânci diferențele dintre elevi și ar putea afecta sănătatea mintală a copiilor.

lithuania.title: NATO dă asigurări că poate aborda „oricare amenințare”. Reacția vizează în special Teheranul
lithuania.description: Alianţa Nord-Atlantică este pregătită să abordeze orice ameninţare şi va face întotdeauna tot ce este necesar pentru a-şi apăra aliaţii, a declarat miercuri un oficial al NATO, relatează Reuters. Afirmaţia a venit ca răspuns la întrebări despre un articol din Financial Times conform căruia Iranul ar lua în considerare atacarea de ţinte militare americane din Europa, în cazul în care preşedintele SUA, Donald Trump, ar escalada războiul.

lithuania.title: Elveția își cheamă cetățenii la urne pentru a lua o decizie istorică privind neutralitatea
lithuania.description: Se pare că alegătorii elvețieni vor respinge luna viitoare propunerile privind o definiție mai strictă a neutralității, care ar împiedica țara să impună sancțiuni economice sau să coopereze cu NATO, potrivit unui sondaj publicat miercuri, transmite reuters.

lithuania.title: Melania „nu agreează” speculațiile privind relația lui Trump cu una dintre colaboratoarele sale. Cine este Nathalie Harp
lithuania.description: Speculațiile privind relația lui Donald Trump cu una dintre cele mai apropiate colaboratoare ale sale o deranjează pe soția sa, Melania, potrivit unor rapoarte. Administrația Trump a ripostat după ce senatorul Jon Ossoff a glumit luni că președintele SUA ar fi distras de o aventură extraconjugală cu Natalie Harp, asistenta executivă a președintelui american în vârstă de 80 de ani.

lithuania.title: Rușii donează miliarde pentru războiul lui Putin din Ucraina. Suma impresionantă strânsă în vistieria statului
lithuania.description: Donatorii ruși au vărsat peste 383 de miliarde de ruble (4,5 miliarde de dolari) în vistieria statului în urma unui apel pentru contribuții voluntare, pe măsură ce costul războiului Moscovei împotriva Ucrainei continuă să crească, informează cotidianul de afaceri Vedomosti, citat de agenția DPA.

lithuania.title: Cazul avionului chinez interceptat de avioane maghiare de luptă la granița cu România. Ancheta a dezvăluit cauza incidentului
lithuania.description: Un avion al companiei Cathay Pacific, cu sediul în Hong Kong, a fost interceptat de două avioane de vânătoare maghiare ale NATO deasupra spațiului aerian românesc. Incidentul a avut loc pe 4 iulie. Acum, ancheta în acest caz arată că pilotul a selectat o frecvență radio greșită după ce a răspuns din greșeală la instrucțiunile controlului de trafic aerian destinate unei alte aeronave.

lithuania.title: Strategia detaliată a NATO pentru un război terestru cu Rusia: drone, zone autonome și ținte surpriză în Kaliningrad
lithuania.description: Alianța Nord-Atlantică a elaborat un plan detaliat de acțiune în cazul unui conflict armat cu Rusia. Acesta a fost denumit „NATO Land Warfighting Concept” — „Concepția NATO privind operațiunile terestre”, relatează ziarul Bild, citând surse. Elaborarea concepției a fost coordonată de maiorul american Andrew Pingray.

lithuania.title: Trump, acuzat că slăbește alianțele SUA, după anunțul privind reducerea exercițiilor alături de Coreea de Sud: „China și Rusia observă”
lithuania.description: Decizia preşedintelui american Donald Trump de a reduce amploarea exerciţiilor militare comune între SUA şi Coreea de Sud este „stupidă şi incoerentă”, a denunţat, luni, senatorul american Jack Reed, principalul reprezentant democrat în Comisia pentru forţele armate, relatează France Presse.

lithuania.title: KUKU ⟩ Õhuhäired lükkasid Zelenskõi ja Eesti suursaadiku volikirjatseremoonia tundide võrra edasi
lithuania.description: Eesti suursaadik Ukrainas Tiina Intelmann andis teisipäeval üle oma volikirja Ukraina presidendile Volodõmõr Zelenskõile. Kiievi Püha Sofia katedraali territooriumil toimunud tseremooniat mõjutas sõjategevus ja kavandatust jäi see mitu tundi hilisemaks, rääkis Intelmann Kuku raadio saates «Sihik».

lithuania.title: Latvian and Lithuanian national militias stand shoulder to shoulder
lithuania.description: Celebrating the 35th anniversary of the National Guard (Zemessardze), the National Guard has signed a memorandum of cooperation with the Lithuanian Riflemen's Union (Lietuvos šaulių sąjunga) to strengthen cooperation and exchange of experience between the two organizations.

lithuania.title: Specdienesti “krata” Ukrainas eliti: apjomīgā korupcijas lietā ierautas gan Zelenskim tuvas personas, gan deputāti
lithuania.description: Ukrainas Nacionālais pretkorupcijas birojs (NABU) un Speciālā pretkorupcijas prokuratūra (SAP) trešdien veic kratīšanas deputātu un amatpersonu mājās, lai atmaskotu noziedzīgu organizāciju, paziņoja NABU. Saskaņā pretkorupcijas iestāžu sniegto informāciju noziedzīgā organizācija darbojās pašreizējo un bijušo Ukrainas parlamenta deputātu vadībā, un tajā iesaistīti arī prezidenta Volodimira Zelenska biroja darbinieki. lithuania.title: Vācu izdevuma rīcībā nonākusi slepena informācija – NATO plāna detaļas Krievijas iebrukuma gadījumā
lithuania.description: NATO ir izstrādāts plāns, kā atvairīt Krievijas armijas iebrukumu kādā no alianses valstīm. Tam esot dots nosaukums “NATO sauszemes kaujas darbību koncepcija”. Par to, atsaucoties uz iekšējo informāciju, raksta vācu izdevums Bild. Atsaucoties uz izdevumam Bild pieejamo informāciju, jaunā NATO un Krievijas kara koncepcija tikusi izstrādāta ASV Bruņoto spēku majora Endrū Pingreja (Andrew Pingrey) vadībā. […]

lithuania.title: Martynas Katelynas sako, kad ginklų naudojimo tvarka VSAT bus koreguojama
lithuania.description: Vidaus reikalų ministras Martynas Katelynas teigia, kad ginklų naudojimo tvarka Valstybės sienos apsaugos tarnyboje (VSAT) koreguojama, tačiau, kokie pokyčiai laukia pasieniečių, kol kas neįvardija.

lithuania.title: NATO griežtai sureagavo į Irano planus pulti Europą: priminė 1 atvejį
lithuania.description: NATO aljansas yra pasirengęs atremti bet kokią grėsmę ir visada darys tai, kas būtina, kad apgintų visus sąjungininkus, – taip NATO atstovas atsakė į klausimus apie dienraščio „Financial Times“ (FT) pranešimą, kad Iranas svarstė galimybę pulti JAV karinius objektus Europoje, jei Donaldas Trumpas eskaluotų karą.

lithuania.title: Nelaimė Alytaus rajone: prašoma pagalbos per gaisrą viską praradusiai šeimai
lithuania.description: Pivašiūnų seniūnas Algis Marcinkevičius viešai kreipėsi į gyventojus, prašydami padėti be namų ir užgyvento turto likusiai šeimai. Per gaisrą sudegė ne tik šeimos namas, bet ir viskas, kas buvo jame.

lithuania.title: Tikrintojai iškratė „Mercedes“, o netrukus ir BMW: radiniai analogiški, įtariamasis areštinėje
lithuania.description: Pareigūnai tą pačią pavakarę viename mieste tikrino dvi transporto priemones. Ir „Mercedes“, ir BMW automobiliuose aptikta neteisėtų dalykų. Už grotų iškart atsidūrė vienas įtariamasis.

lithuania.title: Siūlo darbą „Wildberries“, bet pakiša „specialią sutartį“: rado naują būdą, kaip privilioti rusus
lithuania.description: Portale „Avito“ ėmė masiškai daugėti darbo skelbimų internetinės prekybos milžinių „Wildberries“ ir „Ozon“ sandėlių apsaugininkų vietoms užimti. Tačiau jų pagalba, kaip rašo naujienų portalas „Viorstka“, vyrai iš tikrųjų viliojami karui į Ukrainą.

lithuania.title: Kęstutis Kėvalas. Tiesos, atsakomybės ir saugios aplinkos kūrimo keliu
lithuania.description: Pastarieji įvykiai sukrėtė mūsų Bažnyčią ir visuomenę. Žinios apie dvasininkams pareikštus kaltinimus dėl labai sunkių nusikaltimų prieš nepilnamečius kelia skausmą, nusivylimą, pyktį ir daugybę klausimų. Apie tai turime kalbėti ir veikti dabar, kad nepasikartotų tokios situacijos ateityje.

lithuania.title: Kilus audrai dėl darbo Raudondvario dvare premjero žmona nutraukė tylą
lithuania.description: Kilus įtarimams dėl premjero žmonos įdarbinimo, pati Aistė Sinkevičienė teigia, kad į darbą buvo priimta pagal galiojančias tvarkas, o viešumoje paskleista informacija yra netiksli.

lithuania.title: Izraelyje pradėtas baudžiamasis tyrimas dėl penkerių mergaitės Hind Rajab žūties Gazos Ruože
lithuania.description: Izraelio kariuomenė trečiadienį pranešė, kad nurodė pradėti baudžiamąjį tyrimą dėl penkerių metų Hind Rajab (Hind Radžab) žūties Gazos Ruože 2024 metais.

lithuania.title: Katelynas prabilo apie Liubajevo problemas: nesilaikė nustatytų tvarkų
lithuania.description: Vidaus reikalų ministras Martynas Katelynas teigia, kad rugpjūčio pradžioje Valstybės sienos apsaugos tarnybos (VSAT) vado atžvilgiu pradėtas tarnybinis patikrinimas nustatė, jog šiuo metu iš pareigų pasitraukęs pasieniečių vadas Rustamas Liubajevas nesilaikė ministro nustatytų tvarkų dėl vadovybės informavimo apie ypatingus įvykius pasienyje.

lithuania.title: Seimo etikos sargai Užsienio reikalų ministerijos skundą dėl Pavilionio išmetė į šiukšlių dėžę
lithuania.description: Seimo Etikos ir procedūrų komisija trečiadienį nusprendė netirti Užsienio reikalų ministerijos (URM) skundo dėl konservatoriaus Žygimanto Pavilionio pokalbių su Lietuvos ambasados Vašingtone darbuotojais.

lithuania.title: Vyriausybė siūlo tobulinti draudimą Rusijoje, Baltarusijoje dirbantiems atlikėjams atvykti į Letuvą
lithuania.description: Vyriausybė siūlo tobulinti konservatorių siūlymą drausti į Lietuvą atvykti užsieniečiams, kurie prasidėjus karui Ukrainoje vykdė kultūrinę ar kitą susijusią veiklą Rusijoje, Baltarusijoje ar jų okupuotose teritorijose.

lithuania.title: „Labanakt, kairioji puse“: Seimo etikos sargai paskelbė verdiktą dėl šios Kasčiūno frazės
lithuania.description: Socialinio tinklo „Facebook“ įraše su kraštutine dešine siejamą frazę „Good night left side“ (liet. „Labanakt, kairioji puse“) panaudojęs konservatorių lyderis Laurynas Kasčiūnas politikų elgesio kodekso nepažeidė.

lithuania.title: Parlamentas patvirtino naują Ukrainos gynybos ministrą
lithuania.description: Ukrainos Aukščiausioji Rada naujuoju šalies gynybos ministru trečiadienį patvirtino buvusį laikinąjį Saugumo tarnybos (SBU) vadovą Jevhenijų Chmarą, pranešė portalas „Ukrajinska pravda“.

lithuania.title: JAV pažadėjo „sugriauti“ Tarptautinį baudžiamąjį teismą: įvedė sankcijas
lithuania.description: JAV prezidento Donaldo Trumpo administracija paskelbė apie sankcijų įvedimą Tarptautinio baudžiamojo teismo (TBT) aukščiausiems pareigūnams – jo pirmininkei, japonėi Tomoko Akane, ir vyresniajam teismo advokatui, senegaliečiui Abdoulaye Seye, skelbia „Bloomberg“ naujienų tarnyba.
